Route to accommodation
🗺 Google Maps
🚇 Step 1

Step 1: After exiting the ticket gate, turn left immediately and go up the escalator toward B1 Exit.

⬆️ Step 2

Step 2: At the top of the escalator, turn left toward B1 Exit. If you continue straight, you can also use the elevator to street level. The elevator route is closer.

🚶 Step 3

Step 3: Walk through the passage toward B1 Exit and go up the stairs to street level. Once outside, turn left.

↩️ Step 4

Step 4: After exiting the station, turn left, then turn left again immediately.

🏢 Step 5

Step 5: Walk a little further and you will see the building on your left.
